Mozilla's [[Sync Firefox data|Sync]] feature lets you synchronize bookmarks, add-ons, browsing history and other information across multiple devices, on a per device basis. This article shows you how to choose these settings. For information on starting a Sync account or managing your devices, see [[How do I set up Sync on my computer?]]

__TOC__

=What information can I share across my devices?=
You can choose to sync the following information on your devices:
*'''Bookmarks:''' this allows you to access all your favorite sites on all your synchronized devices.
*'''History:''' this allows you to access sites you have visited in the past on all your synchronized devices.
*'''Open tabs:''' this allows you to view your open tabs from other devices. See the [[View synced tabs from other devices]] article for details.
*'''Passwords:''' this synchronizes the usernames and passwords you use to log in to websites. If you use a [[Use a Primary Password to protect stored logins and passwords|Primary Password]], see [[Use a Primary Password with Sync]] for important information on how Sync and the Primary Password interact.
*'''Addresses:''' this synchronizes the addresses you use to fill in web forms. See [[Automatically fill in your address on web forms]].<!-- "Addresses" has been reintroduced as a sync choice since at least fx60-->
*'''Payment methods:''' this synchronizes the credit and debit card payment methods data you saved to Firefox. See [[Automatically fill in credit card information on Firefox for Android]] and [[Automatically fill in credit and debit card payment methods data on web forms]].
*'''Add-ons/extensions:''' select this checkbox if you want to synchronize your add-ons/extensions across your devices. Add-ons/extensions for the desktop version of Firefox cannot be synchronized with the mobile versions of Firefox.
*'''[[Template:optionsorpreferences]]:''' this synchronizes Firefox preference settings you've changed, such as your [[How to set the home page|home page]], across desktop devices.
